{{Quote|Oh, these collars are going to do a world of good in the field. Once we get this around those stinking furballs' necks they will be completely under our control.|Mssikss|<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>}}
'''Mssikss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who resided in a [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] camp on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Viewing [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] as little more than animals, she tasked a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] with securing a shipment of [[Shock collar/Legends|slaving collars]] to be used on them.
